## Fixes since beta5

- Corrected macOS window color matching. The Metal surface now declares sRGB after creation, resize and surface recovery, so wide-gamut displays no longer interpret the game's sRGB colors as unmanaged display colors. Game shaders, blending and capture pixels retain their existing arithmetic.
- Prevented unintended bird ability activation after front-side drum bounces in BirdRun, while preserving manual ability input. The bounce compatibility correction covers all birds rather than only Poppy.
- Restored the native angular damping of controllable bodies using official IDA evidence.
- Added coverage for Poppy purchased through the BirdRun top bar. The shipped original configuration keeps its idle expression during sling pull and flight; this behavior is preserved rather than replaced with an inferred animation mapping.
- Retained the beta5 window-close fix, including final pause/save callbacks.

## Downloads and startup

Packages are available for macOS ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64 and Linux x86_64/ARM64. Each contains one directly playable game executable, external `runtime/data`, README, license and build information. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

Extract the complete package and launch `stella-app` (`stella-app.exe` on Windows). Resources remain external; the release program does not embed or automatically extract them, and it starts without a developer CLI. Debug and `diagnostic` builds retain developer options.

To retain progress when replacing an installation, preserve its `runtime/appdata` directory. Release archives contain no player saves or credentials. Windows uses the GUI subsystem and static CRT; Linux requires the system desktop/audio libraries and supported graphics drivers.

The corresponding browser build is deployed to [GitHub Pages](https://lambdaed1th.github.io/angrybirdsstella-rehost/) by the release workflow. Browser progress stays in the browser; save backup/import remains available.

## Verification and status

The fixes passed 1988 workspace development tests with two existing ignored audits, plus strict Clippy on macOS ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64, Linux x86_64/ARM64 and Web/Emscripten. macOS also passed release-mode strict Clippy. The local display audit preserved all raw surface bytes and matched eight sRGB color patches exactly against an independent display-profile conversion, including after a real window resize.

The release workflow separately validates the tagged source, builds all five shipping executables, checks executable architectures and Windows GUI mode, and verifies packaged external resources and SHA-256 checksums. Cross-compilation and local color-patch measurements are not claims of Windows/Linux physical-display parity or complete original-device visual equivalence.

This remains a beta rehost. Full native parity has not been declared. The drum correction remains a compatibility measure pending complete native continuous-collision alignment, and an existing optimized full-suite signed-zero physics regression remains open. Retired online services and real platform payments are not restored. No automatic playthrough implementation is included.

Repository-authored code is AGPL-3.0-or-later. Original game resources retain their respective rights and are not relicensed by the source-code license.
